items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: When Earl Hines had his little band and was playing for afternoon things in Pittsburgh, the boys after the session would come and get me.

ctx.x: reason why I don't understand - never in my life. When Earl Hines had his little band and was playing for afternoon things in Pittsburgh, the boys after the session would come and get me. It's always been that. They'd come and get me and take me to play and anything, if I was playing wrong, they showed me. I was just like one of the boys.
You have always worked with black music, right or not?
